class.name: IfcStructuralLoadSingleForceWarping
class.brief_description: Definition from IAI: Instances of the entity IfcStructuralLoadSingleForceWarping , as a subtype of IfcStructuralLoadSingleForce , shall be used to define an action operation on a single point. In addition to forces and moments defined by its supertype a warping moment can be defined. HISTORY: New entity in Release IFC2x edition 2.

members.member: The warping moment at the point load.
